description:
Usage, session, and revenue analytics (admin-only)

Admin only. Aggregates across every organization over a date window: session outcomes by UTC day, device category, and claimant country; demand per provider, money in by month, and per-org consumption against the plan allowance (including closed periods, which the org-scoped usage endpoint never returns). Defaults to the last 30 days; narrow to one org with `orgId`.

from.description: One end of a date window: either a calendar date (`2026-09-01`, read as UTC midnight) or a full ISO date-time. The date-only form is what a native `<input type="date">` submits, so `format: date-time` alone would reject every filter the dashboard's own form sends.

orgId.description: An organization id used as a filter. Hyphens are ignored, so it matches with or without them; an id that matches no organization returns nothing.

to.description: One end of a date window: either a calendar date (`2026-09-01`, read as UTC midnight) or a full ISO date-time. The date-only form is what a native `<input type="date">` submits, so `format: date-time` alone would reject every filter the dashboard's own form sends.

verificationClientId.description: A verification client id used as a filter. Hyphens are ignored.

name: admin_analytics
